nodes.name: Longing
nodes.picture: a figure at a window turned toward a far horizon, soft warm light on one side of the face, empty space ahead, hand resting on glass
nodes.voice: Reaching, unfinished sentences; wanting named but never quite reached.
nodes.beats: A wish is set just out of reach, and each chapter shows a step toward it or away from it.

nodes.name: Unrequited love
nodes.picture: someone watching another person laugh across a room, gentle light on the beloved, the watcher half in shadow, hands held tight
nodes.voice: Careful, understated lines that circle the thing unsaid.
nodes.beats: One character loves openly or secretly while the other looks elsewhere; small kindnesses go unnoticed.

nodes.name: Forbidden love
nodes.picture: two adults standing close but not touching, a barrier or watching eyes between them, warm light against cold surroundings, fully clothed, intense eye contact
nodes.voice: Hushed, urgent, stolen words with a risk under every line.
nodes.beats: Two people from opposed sides meet in secret; every meeting raises the cost of being found out.

nodes.name: Tenderness
nodes.picture: two figures close together, one adjusting the other's scarf, soft glowing light, warm muted palette, relaxed shoulders, gentle expressions
nodes.voice: Soft, plain, small words that say a lot.
nodes.beats: A quiet act of care in the middle of hardship, noticed and returned.

nodes.name: Saudade
nodes.picture: a lone figure by the sea gazing at empty water, golden haze, faded warm tones, a keepsake of someone absent held lightly
nodes.voice: Lyrical and slow, warmth tinged with ache for what is gone.
nodes.beats: A person keeps a token of a lost love or place and returns to it in thought, content and hurt at once.

nodes.name: Hiraeth
nodes.picture: a traveler on a hill looking toward misty distant mountains of a home that may no longer exist, cool soft light, small figure with hands at sides
nodes.voice: Spare, old-sounding, rooted in land and names.
nodes.beats: An exile remembers a homeland through songs, objects and landscape that cannot be returned to.

nodes.name: Homesickness
nodes.picture: someone sitting alone holding a small keepsake, strange cold surroundings, warm lamplight on the keepsake only, hunched shoulders
nodes.voice: Plain, a little childlike; small details of home repeated.
nodes.beats: A newcomer in a foreign place clings to familiar rituals, a letter, a taste, a song.

nodes.name: Grief
nodes.picture: a figure bowed over a still object, desaturated cold tones, heavy shadow, limp hands, dim light falling from one side
nodes.voice: Short, broken, stunned sentences; silence between them.
nodes.beats: A death lands and the story stays with those left behind in the empty hours after.

nodes.name: Heartbreak
nodes.picture: a person turned away mid-parting with tears and tight shoulders, cool blue light, a hand reaching out and falling short
nodes.voice: Raw, direct, a sentence that stops halfway.
nodes.beats: A bond breaks in a single moment of truth, and the aftermath shows what remains.

nodes.name: Melancholy
nodes.picture: a figure in hushed cool blues and grey, head slightly bowed, soft diffuse light, quiet stillness, muted palette
nodes.voice: Slow, hushed, reflective sentences; long pauses.
nodes.beats: Nothing dramatic happens; a quiet loss colours ordinary moments and the story lingers on them.

nodes.name: Bittersweet
nodes.picture: a smile with wet eyes, warm golden light fading into cool shadow, two tones in one frame, a farewell embrace
nodes.voice: Warm words with a catch in them; joy and loss named together.
nodes.beats: A hard-won happy moment arrives at a cost, or a happy ending requires saying goodbye.

nodes.name: Mono no aware
nodes.picture: falling petals or leaves drifting past a still figure, pale soft light, delicate muted palette, empty space around them, calm acceptance
nodes.voice: Gentle, observational, noticing how brief beautiful things are.
nodes.beats: The story pauses on a passing season, a fading light, a small beauty that will not last.

nodes.name: Nostalgia
nodes.picture: warm faded film tones, soft grain and golden haze, a worn childhood object, relaxed figure smiling at something far away
nodes.voice: Fond, drifting, 'back then' sentences full of small sensory detail.
nodes.beats: A present moment triggers a memory, and the story drifts into the remembered scene.

nodes.name: Disillusionment
nodes.picture: a figure looking at a cracked banner or faded ideal, flat grey light, slumped posture, drained colour, eyes lowered
nodes.voice: Dry, tired, quiet bitterness; 'so this is how it is'.
nodes.beats: A cause or hero is revealed as flawed and a believer must decide what is left to believe.

nodes.name: Dread
nodes.picture: long deep shadows closing around a small figure, sickly muted colour, something just out of sight, rigid wary posture
nodes.voice: Short, flat, ominous sentences; things not said.
nodes.beats: Small wrong details accumulate before anything happens, and characters sense what is coming.

nodes.name: Existential dread
nodes.picture: a tiny figure beneath an enormous empty sky, cold desaturated void, vast negative space, still and silent
nodes.voice: Quiet, abstract, questions with no answer.
nodes.beats: A character glimpses the scale of time or the lack of meaning and cannot unsee it.

nodes.name: Cosmic horror
nodes.picture: colossal incomprehensible shapes in a sickly sky, tiny witnesses frozen in awe and terror, wrong colours and impossible geometry
nodes.voice: Stammering, awed, struggling to describe the indescribable.
nodes.beats: Characters uncover something vast that does not notice or care about them, and understanding is the damage.

nodes.name: Sublime terror
nodes.picture: a towering storm wall or colossal wave over a small figure, dramatic hard light, cold saturated blues, braced bodies, awed faces
nodes.voice: Breathless, overwhelmed, beautiful and frightening at once.
nodes.beats: Nature or a vast power appears, magnificent and lethal, and the characters can only watch.

nodes.name: Uncanny calm
nodes.picture: an eerily tidy scene with everything slightly too perfect, flat even light, pastel palette, still figures with fixed smiles
nodes.voice: Pleasant, polite and slightly off; cheerful words with nothing behind them.
nodes.beats: A quiet, orderly place feels wrong, and the unease grows from how normal everyone acts.

nodes.name: Vertigo
nodes.picture: a figure gripping a ledge over a deep drop, tilted horizon, stretched perspective, pale-knuckled hands, cold light
nodes.voice: Clipped, reeling, repeated words that lose their footing.
nodes.beats: The ground literally or figuratively gives way and a character loses their sense of what is real.

nodes.name: Righteous fury
nodes.picture: a figure standing firm with blazing hard light behind them, red and gold palette, clenched fists, a crowd or injustice before them
nodes.voice: Forceful, declarative, stern; each sentence a verdict.
nodes.beats: A wrong crosses a line and a character finally speaks or acts for those who cannot.

nodes.name: Revenge
nodes.picture: a cold-eyed figure with a worn weapon or a name written down, hard side light, dark red and slate palette, controlled stillness
nodes.voice: Clipped, patient, quiet menace.
nodes.beats: A past wrong drives a long plan; the path forces the avenger to weigh what it will cost them.

nodes.name: Betrayal
nodes.picture: a figure frozen in shock as a trusted companion turns away, light cutting across the faces, cold shadow, an outstretched hand left hanging
nodes.voice: Stunned and cold; the one word that cuts.
nodes.beats: A trusted ally reveals their true loyalty at the worst moment, and every earlier scene is recast.

nodes.name: Resentment
nodes.picture: a figure with folded arms and a sideways glare, muddy greens and greys, flat unfriendly light, tight jaw, turned shoulder
nodes.voice: Terse, sour, old grievances in dry asides.
nodes.beats: A grievance is held for years and surfaces in small slights until it is finally said aloud.

nodes.name: Schadenfreude
nodes.picture: a smug grin at another's mishap, sharp bright light, chin lifted, a rival stumbling in the background, knowing glance
nodes.voice: Smooth, wry, delighted and a touch guilty.
nodes.beats: A rival's plan falls apart in front of everyone, and the watcher cannot hide their glee.

nodes.name: Joy
nodes.picture: bright warm golden light, open smiling faces, saturated colour, loose open-armed posture, motion in the clothes and hair
nodes.voice: Bright, lively, short exclamations.
nodes.beats: Good news or a shared success breaks through, and the story lets everyone celebrate.

nodes.name: Euphoria
nodes.picture: blazing radiant light, spinning figures with arms flung wide, vivid saturated colour, confetti or sparks, ecstatic laughter
nodes.voice: Breathless run-ons and exclamations tumbling over each other.
nodes.beats: After a long ordeal the impossible comes true and the characters burst out in pure release.

nodes.name: Bliss
nodes.picture: eyes closed with a soft smile, warm glowing light, pastel and gold palette, loose relaxed limbs, a sense of floating
nodes.voice: Slow, soft, drifting sentences with no worries in them.
nodes.beats: A character reaches a perfect still moment and the story lets it linger without conflict.

nodes.name: Rapture
nodes.picture: upturned face lit by overhead radiance, hands lifted, shimmering light motes, rich gold and violet palette, tears of wonder
nodes.voice: Hushed, swept up, almost prayer-like.
nodes.beats: A character is moved to the edge of tears by something beautiful or transcendent.

nodes.name: Triumph
nodes.picture: a figure standing victorious with raised fist or arms, strong golden backlight, wind in cloth, cheering crowd, upright confident posture
nodes.voice: Bold, ringing, short declarations of victory.
nodes.beats: A hard-fought goal is finally reached after setbacks, with allies gathering around the winner.

nodes.name: Wonder
nodes.picture: wide eyes and parted lips looking up at something marvelous, clear luminous light, fresh bright colour, a small figure drawn forward
nodes.voice: Curious, hushed, full of questions and 'look at that'.
nodes.beats: A character discovers something new and extraordinary, and the story slows to let it be seen.

nodes.name: Awe
nodes.picture: a tiny figure before something immense, luminous glowing light, vast scale, still reverent posture, expansive composition
nodes.voice: Slow, grand and reverent; short sentences that hold their breath.
nodes.beats: Characters stand before something far larger than themselves, a vista, a being, a truth.

nodes.name: Yearning for adventure
nodes.picture: a figure at the edge of a cliff or gate with a pack on their back, bright wind-swept light, open road beyond, eager forward-leaning stance
nodes.voice: Eager, quick, full of 'what if' and 'someday'.
nodes.beats: A restless character hears the call and leaves the familiar behind for the unknown.

nodes.name: Wanderlust
nodes.picture: a traveler walking a long open road with a worn bag, warm travel-stained palette, wide soft horizon, relaxed unhurried stride
nodes.voice: Easygoing, observant, a travel diary in short entries.
nodes.beats: A character keeps moving, collecting places and people and never settling.

nodes.name: Reverence
nodes.picture: figures bowed or standing silent before an old monument or sacred object, soft shafts of light, symmetrical calm composition, hushed tones
nodes.voice: Formal, quiet, measured; names spoken softly.
nodes.beats: Characters enter a place or ritual of great meaning and behave with deliberate care.

nodes.name: Serenity
nodes.picture: calm, soft diffused light and gentle pastel colour, still water, relaxed upright figure with closed or soft eyes, open quiet space
nodes.voice: Still, clear, unhurried sentences.
nodes.beats: A conflict-free pause where nothing needs doing and the world is simply quiet.

nodes.name: Cozy comfort
nodes.picture: warm amber glow, soft blankets and steaming cups, close small space, relaxed curled posture, rich homey texture
nodes.voice: Warm, small, gently funny; the pleasure of little things.
nodes.beats: A safe snug scene after hardship: food, shelter, company, and nothing pressing.

nodes.name: Relief
nodes.picture: a figure exhaling with slumped shoulders and a weak smile, light breaking through, tension draining from the colours
nodes.voice: Shaky, laughing, 'it's over' sentences.
nodes.beats: The danger passes at last and the characters let out a breath they did not know they were holding.

nodes.name: Ennui
nodes.picture: a figure slumped in a chair staring at nothing, flat even light, washed-out beige and grey, loose limp posture, bare surroundings
nodes.voice: Flat, languid, bored witty asides.
nodes.beats: Days repeat without meaning or appeal, and a character drifts through them waiting for something to matter.

nodes.name: Tension
nodes.picture: taut high contrast with cold edges, rigid bodies, narrowed eyes, sharp angles and hard light on the faces
nodes.voice: Clipped and short, nearly stripped of adjectives.
nodes.beats: Two forces face off and a decision hangs, with time running down.

nodes.name: Slow-burn tension
nodes.picture: a still room with two figures watching each other, thin light, small guarded gestures, simmering quiet, clenched hands under a table
nodes.voice: Measured and quiet, with the weight of what is not said.
nodes.beats: Pressure builds across scenes through small signs, not action, until it finally breaks.

nodes.name: Anticipation
nodes.picture: a figure poised at the start of something, bright crisp light, leaning forward, eyes fixed on a door or road, restless hands
nodes.voice: Quick, bright, counting down.
nodes.beats: A big event is close, and the story builds expectation through preparation and nervous energy.

nodes.name: Catharsis
nodes.picture: a figure releasing a long-held cry or tearful laugh, light breaking through clouds, loosened posture, rain or tears catching light
nodes.voice: Raw and pouring out, then suddenly quiet.
nodes.beats: Pent-up pressure from many chapters finally breaks, and the release changes who they are.

nodes.name: Found-family warmth
nodes.picture: a mismatched group close together around a shared table or fire, warm golden light, overlapping laughter, hands on shoulders
nodes.voice: Warm, teasing, easy overlapping talk with an undercurrent of devotion.
nodes.beats: Outcasts discover they belong with each other and choose each other as family.

nodes.name: Camaraderie
nodes.picture: friends side by side in good humor, bright warm light, shoulders bumping, grinning, a shared task or toast between them
nodes.voice: Banter, inside jokes, quick back-and-forth.
nodes.beats: A team under strain trades jokes and bears the work together, growing closer through it.

nodes.name: Protectiveness
nodes.picture: a figure standing between a smaller companion and a threat, strong side light, braced stance, steady unflinching gaze
nodes.voice: Low, firm, short assurances.
nodes.beats: Someone vulnerable is threatened and a character steps forward and takes the danger on.

nodes.name: Loneliness
nodes.picture: a small figure alone in a wide empty space, cold desaturated tones, one lit window far away, hunched posture, long distance from others
nodes.voice: Sparse, quiet, talking to no one.
nodes.beats: A character moves through crowds or empty rooms without anyone knowing them.

nodes.name: Trust
nodes.picture: two figures with open palms or one handing the other something precious, soft even light, steady eye contact, relaxed shoulders
nodes.voice: Plain, direct, a sincere short line.
nodes.beats: A guarded character takes a risk by relying on someone, and the other proves worthy.

nodes.name: Shame
nodes.picture: a figure with lowered head and covering hands, harsh exposing light, shrunken posture, eyes turned from the viewer
nodes.voice: Quiet, halting, self-accusing.
nodes.beats: A mistake is exposed and a character cannot meet others' eyes or their own.

nodes.name: Pride
nodes.picture: a figure with lifted chin and straight back, strong warm light, bold saturated colour, hands on hips or hand over heart
nodes.voice: Firm, composed, a short line that says 'look what we did'.
nodes.beats: A character stands before someone who matters and shows what they have earned.

nodes.name: Survivor's guilt
nodes.picture: a lone figure standing among empty chairs or belongings of others, grey flat light, heavy shoulders, hands closed on a keepsake
nodes.voice: Low, repetitive, why-me questions turned inward.
nodes.beats: A survivor lives with the question of why they were spared when others were not.

nodes.name: Jealousy
nodes.picture: a figure watching two others from a doorway, sharp green-tinted shadow, tight jaw, clenched fingers on the frame
nodes.voice: Tense, clipped, clipped comparisons.
nodes.beats: Someone sees another get the attention, praise or love they wanted, and it sours their view of everything.

nodes.name: Humiliation
nodes.picture: a figure in the center of a ring of watching faces, harsh spotlight, flushed cheeks, shrinking posture, laughter around them
nodes.voice: Stiff, flustered, every word a mistake.
nodes.beats: A character is exposed or laughed at in public, and the story stays inside the burn of it.

nodes.name: Whimsy
nodes.picture: playful pastel colours and gentle odd details, tilted hats and floating objects, soft bright light, light skipping poses
nodes.voice: Light, odd and delighted, with tiny digressions.
nodes.beats: Strange small marvels appear without explanation, and everyone accepts them cheerfully.

nodes.name: Absurdity
nodes.picture: a deadpan figure amid a ridiculous impossible scene, flat bright light, stiff composed faces, logic-defying objects, symmetrical framing
nodes.voice: Straight-faced and matter-of-fact about nonsense.
nodes.beats: A ridiculous situation is handled with total seriousness, and logic gives way.

nodes.name: Gallows humor
nodes.picture: a grinning figure in grim surroundings, harsh uneven light, tired eyes, a joke raised with a cup, ragged cheerful bravado
nodes.voice: Dark, quick, quips thrown at the worst moment.
nodes.beats: Characters in dire straits crack jokes to hold fear off, and the laughter is half a sob.

nodes.name: Mischief
nodes.picture: a sly sideways grin, bright warm light, a hand hidden behind the back, quick light poses, sparkling eyes
nodes.voice: Sly, quick, tongue-in-cheek.
nodes.beats: A trickster sets a prank in motion and enjoys the chaos it makes.

nodes.name: Awkwardness
nodes.picture: stiff figures with averted eyes, bright flat light, a gap between them, fidgeting hands, forced half smiles
nodes.voice: Stumbling, over-polite, trailing off.
nodes.beats: A social moment goes wrong and both people try to pretend it did not happen.

nodes.name: Hope against the odds
nodes.picture: a small group lifting their eyes to a thin break of dawnlike light in a stormy sky, bruised but upright, light on their faces
nodes.voice: Steady, simple, defiantly bright sentences.
nodes.beats: All seems lost, then a small sign makes the characters choose to try one more time.

nodes.name: Defiance
nodes.picture: a figure facing a much larger force with feet planted, hard rim light, torn clothes, raised chin, fists or weapon steady
nodes.voice: Hard, loud, 'no' repeated.
nodes.beats: A character refuses to submit when yielding is easy, and their stand inspires others.

nodes.name: Liberation
nodes.picture: broken chains or an opened gate with a figure running into bright open light, arms wide, wind in hair, flooding colour
nodes.voice: Open and breathless, long free-running sentences.
nodes.beats: Chains fall, a gate opens, and the freed move into a world with no walls.

nodes.name: Redemption
nodes.picture: a figure kneeling then rising in dawn-warm light, scarred but steady, hands open, shadow behind them lifting
nodes.voice: Honest, plain, spare confession and then a step forward.
nodes.beats: A wrongdoer pays for what they did through action, and others slowly let them back in.

nodes.name: Quiet resolve
nodes.picture: a figure tightening a strap or lacing boots with a steady gaze ahead, calm neutral light, grounded stance, minimal gesture
nodes.voice: Calm, brief, no speeches; 'I'll go'.
nodes.beats: A character makes the hard choice without fanfare and simply begins.

nodes.name: Infatuation
nodes.picture: a young adult stealing glances across a room, flushed cheeks, a half-hidden smile, bright warm light, hands fidgeting with a sleeve
nodes.voice: Giddy run-on sentences, exclamation, lists of tiny details about them.
nodes.beats: A new person lights up an ordinary day; the lead keeps finding reasons to look, to be near, to blush.

nodes.name: First love
nodes.picture: two young adults sitting a careful distance apart on a step, shy glances, soft spring light, awkward hands, everything freshly washed in colour
nodes.voice: Hesitant, earnest, every small thing treated as enormous.
nodes.beats: Two people learn each other for the first time; every touch, note and joke is new and carries too much weight.

nodes.name: Love at first sight
nodes.picture: one face in a crowd lit as if by a spotlight, the surrounding figures soft and blurred, wide eyes, a held breath, shimmering warm light
nodes.voice: Hushed, stunned, time suspended mid-sentence.
nodes.beats: The world stops when two strangers meet each other's eyes; nothing else is heard until the moment breaks.

nodes.name: Flirtatious spark
nodes.picture: two adults trading teasing looks across a table, raised eyebrows, playful half-smiles, warm bright light, leaning in a little
nodes.voice: Quick, teasing, double-edged banter with a wink in every line.
nodes.beats: Sharp witty exchanges between two people who clearly enjoy sparring; the chemistry shows before either admits it.

nodes.name: Enemies to lovers
nodes.picture: two rivals face to face with locked stares and clenched fists, sparks of warm and cold light meeting between them, tension softening at the edges
nodes.voice: Clipped insults that slowly lose their edge and start to mean something else.
nodes.beats: Rivals forced together keep clashing until a shared danger or a quiet moment shows each the other's worth.

nodes.name: Burning passion
nodes.picture: two adults in a desperate embrace, rain streaming over them, fully clothed and drenched, deep red and amber light, eyes closed, faces close
nodes.voice: Breathless, urgent, fragmentary, everything said at once.
nodes.beats: Held-back feeling finally breaks open; the scene runs on urgency, weather and a point of no return.

nodes.name: Devotion
nodes.picture: an older couple's steady hands working side by side, a hand placed on a shoulder, low steady golden light, calm upright posture, quiet certainty
nodes.voice: Plain, steady, repeated promises kept in small acts.
nodes.beats: Love shown by showing up again and again over years; a hard season tests it and the lead chooses them anyway.

nodes.name: Adoration from afar
nodes.picture: a figure gazing up at a distant balcony or stage, hand pressed to the chest, soft golden glow on the beloved, long distance between them
nodes.voice: Courtly, lyrical, idealising, praise too large to be said aloud.
nodes.beats: One person quietly worships another who never notices; the devotion shows in rituals, letters and watching from the edge.

nodes.name: The confession
nodes.picture: two adults facing each other, one taking a held breath with a trembling hand reaching out, tight framing on both faces, warm light waiting to break
nodes.voice: Halting, stripped back, the one true sentence finally said.
nodes.beats: The story builds toward the held breath before 'I love you'; the pause is longer than the words.

nodes.name: Reunion
nodes.picture: two adults running toward each other across a platform or open field, arms opening into an embrace, wind in their coats, luminous warm light
nodes.voice: Overlapping half-sentences, laughter caught in tears.
nodes.beats: After a long separation the lovers see each other and close the distance at a run; the embrace is the payoff.

nodes.name: Love's sacrifice
nodes.picture: an adult placing a keepsake in a loved one's hand and stepping back, a calm face with wet eyes, one bright shaft of light between them, an empty road behind
nodes.voice: Quiet, certain, nearly gentle; the cost is never mentioned.
nodes.beats: One lover gives up what they most want so the other can have a future; the act is calm and the aftermath heavy.

nodes.name: Rekindled love
nodes.picture: two adults meeting years later, an old letter or photograph between their hands, warm light slowly returning to their faces, cautious hopeful smiles
nodes.voice: Careful, a little wry, old jokes returning one at a time.
nodes.beats: An old flame catches again; the leads carry their past with them and decide to try anyway.

nodes.name: Obsessive love
nodes.picture: a figure watching from a doorway or window with fixed eyes, a wall of clippings and photos behind, harsh cold light, tight clenched hands
nodes.voice: Fixed, repetitive, tender words with a chill under them.
nodes.beats: Devotion turns possessive and dangerous; the object of it begins to feel watched and the story becomes a warning.

nodes.name: Love-hate
nodes.picture: two adults leaning in to argue then pulling back, one turning away while still holding the other's sleeve, hard and warm light split across their faces
nodes.voice: Barbed, contradictory, 'I can't stand you' with the door left open.
nodes.beats: Two people cannot stay apart and cannot agree; each fight pulls them closer and each retreat hurts.

nodes.name: Secret love
nodes.picture: two adults exchanging a glance across a crowded room, hands brushing out of sight, one eye on the door, dim intimate light with watching figures in shadow
nodes.voice: Coded, murmured, double meanings in ordinary words.
nodes.beats: A love no one may know about lives in hidden glances, notes and stolen minutes; discovery is always one step away.

nodes.name: Mature love
nodes.picture: an old couple on a bench with their hands held, fully clothed in worn comfortable coats, soft late-afternoon light, relaxed shoulders, quiet shared smiles
nodes.voice: Slow, dry, affectionate; whole histories in a few words.
nodes.beats: Decades of shared life show in small habits; the story treasures the quiet over the dramatic.

nodes.name: Parting
nodes.picture: two adults at a train station or dock, one stepping away while the other holds on to a hand until it slips, a last long look, cool evening light, a small bag on the ground
nodes.voice: Few words, said evenly, with everything else in the pauses.
nodes.beats: A farewell is drawn out as long as it can be; the last look and the moment the hands separate carry the scene.

edges.why: Absurdist reading of an uncaring cosmos.
Infatuation held at a distance becomes quiet adoration.
The brave step from afar to speaking.
Watching from afar tends to become unrequited.
The hope of seeing them again.
Flirting and the fumbling beats around it share scenes.
Betrayal is a common cause of heartbreak.
Suspicion either follows or seeds a breach.
A wrong done to the innocent.
grief -> bittersweet -> hope: mourning softens into mixed feeling.
Love's sacrifice is the textbook bittersweet beat.
Joy and loss in one image.
Heat of conflict feeds heat of love (emotional intensity only).
Tension -> release is the basic dramatic arc.
Awe and terror at the vast.
Home's comfort is the longed-for payoff.
Devotion is tested by giving everything.
Devotion across years becomes settled love.
Steady commitment shows as quiet resolve.
The past was brighter than the present.
Fall then rise (man in a hole).
The quiet before; horror lives in stillness.
Sparring banter is the common doorway to the trope.
Rivals pass through love-hate before admitting the turn.
Hostility converts to charged tension in the deepening phase.
The turn resolves in an admission.
Facing the void by choosing meaning.
Infatuation matures into the tender, awkward first love.
First love is the prime thing remembered.
Early attraction shows up as playful teasing.
Banter that deepens into charged restraint.
Dark jokes deliberately set against loss.
The empty place at the table.
Acute grief fades into a low, lingering sorrow.
Heroic/revenge plots begin with a loss.
Mourning those who died while you lived.
The aftermath settles into a low, quiet sorrow.
Longing for a lost home is the place-bound version.
Two cultural words for absent-place longing.
Pull toward home vs pull to leave.
Odds-defying hope pays off as triumph.
A failed confession stings in public.
New attachment brings fear of losing it (jealousy).
The instant spark settles into obsessive-pleasant infatuation (Hayes: meet cute -> falling in love).
After the goodbye, the ache of absence.
Classic setup -> payoff: yearning resolved by being together.
Saudade is longing for what is absent.
Restraint and wanting are the same ache.
Old grievances keep the push-pull alive.
Second chances age into mature love.
Prolonged unrequited love settles as melancholy.
Separation sets up the romantic reunion.
Opposed self-evaluations that stories turn between.
Revenge or redemption: the fork of heroic plots.
Atoning by living well or saving others.
Reunion of lovers often relights the bond.
Saying it releases the held breath.
Terror before the divine becomes reverence.
Hidden feelings sustain the slow burn.
Calm that is wrong against calm that is true.
Held restraint pays off in the declaration.
Deepening desire is built on growing trust.
Wonder pulls the hero out the door.

sources.cite: Thornton & Tamir (2017). Mental models accurately predict emotion transitions. PNAS 114(23):5982-5987.
sources.used_for: Transitions and co-occurrence between emotions; people predict next emotions from similarity, valence, social impact and co-occurrence.

sources.cite: Cowen & Keltner (2017). Self-report captures 27 distinct categories of emotion bridged by continuous gradients. PNAS 114(38):E7900-E7909.
sources.used_for: Gradient neighbours (awe-peacefulness, horror-sadness, amusement-adoration): cooccur links within and across families.

sources.cite: Plutchik wheel of emotions, primary/secondary dyads (joy+trust=love, anticipation+joy=optimism, sadness+disgust=remorse, joy+fear=guilt, fear+sadness=despair).
Reagan, Mitchell, Kiley, Danforth & Dodds (2016). The emotional arcs of stories are dominated by six basic shapes. EPJ Data Science 5:31.
sources.used_for: Arc shapes (man in a hole, Cinderella, Icarus, Oedipus, tragedy, rags to riches) justifying fall->rise pairs: tension->catharsis, grief->bittersweet->hope, loneliness->found family.

sources.cite: Hogan, P. C. (2011). Affective Narratology: The Emotional Structure of Stories. University of Nebraska Press.
sources.used_for: Prototype plots: heroic (pride/anger), sacrificial (fear, atonement), romantic (attachment, separation, reunion); parent-child separation, revenge, criminality.

sources.cite: Hayes, G. Romancing the Beat: Story Structure for Romance Novels (4 phases, 20 beats: setup, falling in love, retreat from love / black moment, fighting for love / grand gesture).
sources.used_for: Romance beat order: meet cute -> adhesion -> deepening desire -> dark moment -> grand gesture -> HEA.

story.notes: Research basis: web-searched/verified abstracts of Thornton&Tamir 2017, Cowen&Keltner 2017, Reagan 2016, Hogan 2011 (summary level), Plutchik dyads, Hayes beat sheet. Full transition-probability matrices and the Warriner/NRC-VAD norms were NOT downloaded, so weights are expert judgement anchored to those sources, not computed from their numbers; no feature fixes proposed for that reason. Structure: (1) hubs -- tension, grief, relief, catharsis, trust, longing, defiance, bittersweet, dread should carry the most cross-family bridges; they are the connective tissue between romance, war, horror and comedy. (2) Use dir a->b as a directed transition (act-order), 'both' as undirected; kind arc_pair = setup->payoff (give these the strongest synapse weight and prefer them for blend neighbours). (3) 'contrast' links (gallows-humor/dread, gallows-humor/grief, shame/pride, revenge/redemption, love's-sacrifice/obsessive-love, hiraeth/wanderlust) are deliberate juxtapositions: render as dashed or lower-weight synapses. (4) Keep the existing feature-kNN edges as a faint background layer (they capture visual/aesthetic similarity) and layer these narrative links on top. (5) Love and passion family stays emotional-intensity only; the links reference only gaze/confession/union beats, nothing sexual.

links.why: The instant spark settles into obsessive-pleasant infatuation (Hayes: meet cute -> falling in love).
Infatuation matures into the tender, awkward first love.
Early attraction shows up as playful teasing.
Infatuation held at a distance becomes quiet adoration.
New attachment brings fear of losing it (jealousy).
Flirting and the fumbling beats around it share scenes.
Banter that deepens into charged restraint.
Sparring banter is the common doorway to the trope.
Rivals pass through love-hate before admitting the turn.
Hostility converts to charged tension in the deepening phase.
The turn resolves in an admission.
Heat of conflict feeds heat of love (emotional intensity only).
Old grievances keep the push-pull alive.
Held restraint pays off in the declaration.
Restraint and wanting are the same ache.
Hidden feelings sustain the slow burn.
Deepening desire is built on growing trust.
Watching from afar tends to become unrequited.
The brave step from afar to speaking.
Prolonged unrequited love settles as melancholy.
A failed confession stings in public.
Saying it releases the held breath.
Devotion is tested by giving everything.
Devotion across years becomes settled love.
Steady commitment shows as quiet resolve.
Love's sacrifice is the textbook bittersweet beat.
After the goodbye, the ache of absence.
Separation sets up the romantic reunion.
The aftermath settles into a low, quiet sorrow.
Betrayal is a common cause of heartbreak.
Classic setup -> payoff: yearning resolved by being together.
Longing for a lost home is the place-bound version.
Saudade is longing for what is absent.
Reunion of lovers often relights the bond.
Second chances age into mature love.
First love is the prime thing remembered.
Suspicion either follows or seeds a breach.
grief -> bittersweet -> hope: mourning softens into mixed feeling.
Acute grief fades into a low, lingering sorrow.
The empty place at the table.
Mourning those who died while you lived.
Heroic/revenge plots begin with a loss.
Dark jokes deliberately set against loss.
The past was brighter than the present.
Two cultural words for absent-place longing.
Pull toward home vs pull to leave.
Home's comfort is the longed-for payoff.
Joy and loss in one image.
Fall then rise (man in a hole).
The quiet before; horror lives in stillness.
Facing the void by choosing meaning.
Awe and terror at the vast.
Absurdist reading of an uncaring cosmos.
Terror before the divine becomes reverence.
Calm that is wrong against calm that is true.
A wrong done to the innocent.
Revenge or redemption: the fork of heroic plots.
Odds-defying hope pays off as triumph.
Wonder pulls the hero out the door.
Tension -> release is the basic dramatic arc.
Opposed self-evaluations that stories turn between.
Atoning by living well or saving others.
The hope of seeing them again.
